name: tirur-connect-react
description: Tirur Connect monorepo: Express/MongoDB backend and Vite/React frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "wait-on --timeout 60000 http-get://localhost:5000/health && npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
